texts.content:
Downtown Farmers Market @dtfarmersmarket

We're back! Opening day is this Saturday, May 10, from 8 A.M. to 1 P.M. in the Central Library parking lot.

This year we have more than 30 vendors, including six new farms selling fresh eggs, honey, flowers, and spring vegetables. Don't miss the cooking demo by Chef Ana Ruiz at 10 A.M., where she'll make a salad using only market ingredients.

A few reminders: Most vendors accept cards, but bring cash for the smaller stands. Dogs are welcome on a short leash. Parking is free in the garage on 2nd Street.

The market runs every Saturday through October. See you there! 🌻
